QuestionStmt.S: Method of preparation of alkyl halide $$2R-Br + Hg_2F_2 \rightarrow 2R-F + Hg_2Br_2$$ This reaction is known as

Solution.S:
The reaction 
$2R-Br + Hg_2F_2 \rightarrow 2R-F + Hg_2Br_2$ 

is used to prepare alkyl fluorides from alkyl bromides. In this reaction, bromine in R–Br is replaced by fluorine using a metallic fluoride such as Hg₂F₂. This halogen exchange method for preparing alkyl fluorides is called the Swartz reaction. Thus, the correct option is B.
